findings.issue: No test infrastructure at all: no test script, no vitest/@builder.io/qwik/testing, zero spec files, despite Qwik's one-command 'qwik add vitest' path.
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest plus @builder.io/qwik/testing (component tests via createDOM) and a `test` script; start by unit-testing the exported pure functions in src/lib/data.ts.

findings.issue: fetchJson caches settled promises including failures, so a single transient API error permanently serves null (blank sprites, missing types, empty catalog) until process restart; no test would catch this.
findings.suggestion: Don't cache rejected/empty results (or add TTL/retry), and add a unit test with a mocked fetch that recovers after one failure.

findings.issue: speciesCardsFromRefs packs the spec's trickiest rules (alternate-form exclusion via id>=10000, dedup, hidden-ability flag merge) with no coverage; a regression silently leaks Mega forms into Learned by / ability lists.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with fixture refs containing deoxys-attack (id 10021), duplicate species, and hidden-ability entries.

findings.issue: Move-table assembly (dedup key method:moveName, default game = highest order, method ordering map, level-then-name default sort) is untested and encodes several precise spec rules.
findings.suggestion: Extract the grouping/sorting into a pure function and unit-test the ordering rules and dedup behavior.

findings.issue: Home filtering and pagination (48/page, page clamping, slice bounds) is pure computed logic with no unit coverage; an off-by-one in slice or clamping would only be caught by the full acceptance run.
findings.suggestion: Extract matching/paging into a pure function and test the boundary cases (exactly 48, 49, page beyond range, unknown type name).

findings.issue: parseHomeQuery and homeUrl (app/src/routes/index.tsx:16-25) round-trip URL state with no tests for page=0, page=abc, empty/default param omission.
findings.suggestion: Add property-ish unit tests asserting parse(homeUrl(x)) round-trips for defaults and edge inputs.

findings.issue: compareRows must keep missing values last in both directions; the common refactor of negating the whole comparator breaks descending order and nothing would fail.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test ascending and descending sorts over rows with null power/accuracy, and assert the flip behavior of the column sort state.

findings.issue: All fetch errors collapse to null, so an API outage renders 'No Pokémon found' on the home page and the generic NotFound on detail pages — indistinguishable from missing resources, and untested.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish error from not-found (throw or return a tagged result) and test the outage rendering path.

summary: The app ships no tests of its own: no runner, no script, no spec files, despite Qwik's first-class Vitest integration and an almost entirely pure, exported data layer that begs for unit tests. The riskiest logic — promise caching, alternate-form dedup, move-table grouping, home filtering/pagination, and the descending-sort missing-last rule — is guarded only by the external acceptance suite, so a data-layer refactor would land blind. One high-value, low-effort step is wiring `qwik add vitest` and unit-testing the pure functions in src/lib/data.ts plus the sort/comparator logic.
